target_customer: AI app and agent developers, mapping, retail, real estate, ad and KYB companies needing fresh place data.
problem: Maps expose 10 to 15 attributes per place and go stale. VOYGR builds richer, continuously validated place profiles and a PlaceCall API so agents can phone businesses.
business_model: Usage based data and API (validation, enrichment, PlaceCall); first 250 calls free
product_category: Place intelligence API for AI agents

founders.name: Yarik Markov
founders.background_notes: YC page: about 10 years leading Infra, ML and Search teams.

competitors.name: Foursquare Places API
competitors.what: Places data with about 100 million POIs and agent integrations

competitors.name: Brave Place Search API
competitors.what: Lower cost places search for agents

technical_complexity.rationale: Fresh place data requires crawling and ML entity resolution at scale; voice calling adds another layer; the team has deep maps and ML experience.

defensibility.rationale: Data freshness could compound, but Google, Foursquare and Overture data are strong and open alternatives exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Google and others offer agent facing APIs; no acquisition found.

market_need_then: Agents increasingly use maps data and need fresher context; the company cites 20M plus apps needing local context (self reported).

identity.voice_and_tone: Punchy; tagline Maps tag places. VOYGR understands them.

branding.community_and_virality: Launched on Hacker News as a Launch HN in March 2026 (listed by aggregators).

brand_strength.rationale: Vowel dropped spelling resembling Voyager is memorable but hard to say; limited external brand coverage.

outcome_analysis: VOYGR is an active Winter 2026 company whose CEO led Google Maps API go to market and whose CTO led search and ML teams. It has Overture Maps and RepRally as early users per aggregators; no verified funding or outcome yet, and Google plus open data providers are the main competitive pressure.
notes: EveryDev lists a $500,000 pre-seed or seed in January 2026 from Y Combinator and SNR.VC; single aggregator, unverified. Founded year not given on sources I opened. Competitor sources are dated only as 2026. Yarik Markov's surname appears in the YC page text and a second source did not confirm it; education not listed for him. Completeness pass: the 500K USD round (2026-01, labeled pre-seed or seed) is now recorded from EveryDev alone; PitchBook also shows 500K with a partial investor list. SNR.VC is from EveryDev only.
